items.description: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

items.title: Why unique Brighton defence is so tricky to unpick

items.title: The oldest club in London making FA Cup history
items.description: Cray Wanderers host Stockport County in the FA Cup first round, with 112 league places separating the two sides.

items.title: 'The worst conditions in my 35-year career' - commentating in the FA Cup fog
items.description: BBC Sport commentator Steve Bower gives an insight into trying to commentate when thick fog engulfs a stadium and you can barely see the action.

items.title: 'It's Savage junior's night' - Charlie scores against dad Robbie's side
items.description: Robbie Savage's son Charlie scores for Reading against Peterborough United, the side his father manages in the first round of the FA Cup.

items.description: Charlie Savage scores his first goal of the season and puts in a man-of-the-match performance for Reading who knock out dad Robbie's Peterborough United in the FA Cup first round.

items.title: 'Wonderful goal' - Crewe's McNeill scores from halfway line

items.title: 'Curtains for Robinson' or can floundering Aberdeen boss survive?

items.title: Was Leeds' Bogle lucky to escape red card?
items.description: Match of the Day's Steph Houghton and Danny Murphy assess whether a challenge from Leeds United's Jayden Bogle on Tottenham's Mathys Tel was worthy of a red card.

items.title: Forest win over Man City 'a turning point' - Murphy
items.description: Match of the Day's Danny Murphy breaks down Nottingham Forest's impressive 3-1 win over Manchester City, a victory that he believes could be "a turning point" in Forest's first season under Oliver Glasner.

items.title: Arsenal should have been awarded penalty against Hull - Cann
items.description: Former Premier League assistant referee Darren Cann explains why Arsenal should have been awarded a penalty for a foul on Kai Havertz in the Premier League champions' 1-0 win over Hull City.
